contexts.text: They draw down spiritual truths to earthly things... As for example... they draw down the things of marriage love to whoredoms...
Arcana, which cannot be opened without much explication and ample deduction.
I will bring you back to the Land... () = to elevate to Heaven.
If he were to see the veriest Divine miracles, he would draw them down into nature, and there defile them...
[Swedenborg footnote 2.]. As to his spirit, man can be drawn away to a distance while his body remains in its own place. References.
They who distinguish between spiritual and natural things, and deduce the latter from the former...
The simple see better from comparisons than from deductions formed analytically from the Word and at the same time from reason.
He drew Truths by deductions from natural things...
He shall lead them away to living fountains of waters () = into Divine truths.
Thou shall lead her away into the midst of thine house ()... = that it shall be led into the interior things of the Church.
That they are to be removed through temptations, is signified by I will lead you away into the wilderness ().
